projects.name: The star observatory
projects.purpose: A raised stone platform where scholars chart the sky and record what they learn.

projects.purpose: A lit path from the square to the fields so no one walks home in the dark.

projects.name: The field pavilion
projects.purpose: A shaded open pavilion beside the fields for rest, reading and shared meals.

projects.purpose: A new home for the neighbours who are arriving; each cottage is built by the village together.

projects.name: The orchard fence and gate

projects.name: The research tower
projects.purpose: A slim glass-banded tower where scholars gather the village's findings into one view.

projects.name: The solar array
projects.purpose: Rows of solar glass that charge the village lamps by day and light the paths all night.

projects.name: The vertical farm
projects.purpose: A stacked greenhouse tower where crops grow in bright rooms, feeding more people from less land.

projects.purpose: A basin of light and lamps where neighbours rest after a day of work.

projects.purpose: A spacious open hall with visible forge-free craft benches for textile, wood, and ceramic artisans.

projects.name: The material recycling garden
projects.purpose: Tidy stone sorting bays where unused clay, timber trimmings and metal offcuts are sorted for reuse.
